name: 36613 · Eight Mile, AL
findings: ZIP 36613 (Eight Mile) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 36613 (Eight Mile) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 36613 (Eight Mile) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 18% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
